summary: Aris Mining Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing an NI 43-101 technical report, a prefeasibility study for the Toroparu gold project in the Cuyuni-Mazaruni region of Guyana, effective and dated November 12, 2026. No securities transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership/regulatory mechanics are stated; the filing is a routine technical disclosure, the Canadian-equivalent of a US technical report exhibit, not a special situation. Watch future construction decisions, permitting, and capital-cost updates as the operative catalysts rather than deal terms.
